article.story: ORONO, Maine -- — Belal El Shakery scored 11 points to help New Hampshire defeat Maine 65-48 on Monday. El Shakery also contributed seven rebounds for the Wildcats (5-12, 1/3 America East Conference). John Squire scored 10 points while finishing 5 of 7 from the floor and added eight rebounds. Tyler Bike had 10 points and shot 4 for 7. The win broke a five-game slide for the Wildcats. Keelan Steele led the Black Bears (3-17, 1-4) in scoring, finishing with nine points and eight rebounds. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
